q.en: The API number can also stay on the WhatsApp phone app.
q.hi: API number WhatsApp phone app pe bhi reh sakta hai.

x.en: False. An API number can't be on any WhatsApp app.
x.hi: Galat. API number kisi WhatsApp app pe nahi ho sakta.

q.en: Minimum age of the Facebook account needed?
q.hi: Facebook account kam se kam kitna purana chahiye?

q.en: How many agents can share one number in live chat?
q.hi: Live chat mein ek number pe kitne agents ho sakte hain?

q.en: Daily limit can grow up to…
q.hi: Daily limit kahan tak badh sakti hai?

x.en: From about 2,000 up to 1,00,000 with good use.
x.hi: Lagbhag 2,000 se 1,00,000 tak, achhe use ke saath.

q.hi: OTP template kis category mein aata hai?

x.en: Authentication is for one-time passwords only.
x.hi: Authentication sirf OTP ke liye hai.

q.en: Do you upload the real image when creating an image template?
q.hi: Image template banate waqt asli image upload karte hain?

en: No, you add it when sending the campaign
hi: Nahi, campaign bhejte waqt add karte hain

x.en: The real media is added at send time.
x.hi: Asli media bhejte waqt add hota hai.

q.en: How long does Meta usually take to review a template?
q.hi: Meta template review mein aam taur pe kitna time leta hai?

q.en: Best campaign type for a new Excel list of people?
q.hi: Logon ki nayi Excel list ke liye best campaign type?

x.en: CSV broadcast uploads a new list.
x.hi: CSV broadcast nayi list upload karta hai.

x.en: Only sent and delivered messages are charged.
x.hi: Sirf sent aur delivered ka charge lagta hai.

q.en: Order-dispatched messages sent automatically by the Oribrix system use…
q.hi: Oribrix system se apne aap jaane wale order-dispatched messages kya use karte hain?

x.en: The API sends messages automatically when events happen.
x.hi: API events hone pe apne aap messages bhejta hai.

x.en: Under Manage, API key, read API.
x.hi: Manage, API key, read API mein.

q.en: Within 24 hours of a customer's message you can…
q.hi: Customer ke message ke 24 ghante ke andar aap…

x.en: Inside the 24-hour window, any text is allowed.
x.hi: 24 ghante ki window mein koi bhi text chal jaata hai.

q.en: Why use tags like 'hot lead' or 'complaint'?

en: To filter, follow up and hand over chats
hi: Filter, follow-up aur chats hand over karne ke liye

x.en: Tags make follow-up and filtering easy.
x.hi: Tags se follow-up aur filter aasaan hota hai.

x.en: Respect the opt-out; it keeps the number healthy.
x.hi: Opt-out ka samman kijiye; isse number healthy rehta hai.

q.en: Who should have the Owner role?

x.en: Owners control billing, settings and the API key.
x.hi: Owner billing, settings aur API key control karta hai.
